visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A shirtless, fit Asian man with facial hair holds a large white and ginger fluffy cat against his chest in a brightly lit, minimalist indoor hallway. He speaks energetically to the camera, using hand gestures while holding the cat. (2) Dynamic graphic overlays, including lightning bolts, money icons, a cartoon chicken, and arrows, appear around the man as he continues his monologue, his facial expressions shifting from serious to questioning. (3) The scene transitions to the man holding a circular white fragrance device; he brings it to his nose to smell it. A split-screen effect shows the device on a home office desk and the man reading a book in a white-themed bedroom. (4) He demonstrates the physical components of the product, showing a blue version of the machine and inserting a white fragrance capsule. Close-up shots highlight the Type-C charging port and the texture of the device. (5) The background behind the man digitally changes to represent different scents, featuring scenic ocean views, pine forests, and a map of the Mediterranean. He holds up various product refill packs with French branding. (6) Visual metaphors for the scents are shown, including macro close-ups of white flowers and white fabric sheets flapping in the breeze under a clear sky. (7) The man holds both the white and blue fragrance machines in his hands, looking directly at the camera while delivering a concluding speech in a well-lit room.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male speaker begins with a high-energy, fast-paced delivery in Mandarin Chinese. A bright, high-tempo electronic pop BGM with a steady 4/4 beat (~124 BPM) plays in the background. A stylized cat meow SFX punctuates the opening. (2) Frequent digital 'pop' and 'ding' sound effects trigger as variety text appears visually. The vocal intensity remains high with rising intonation. (3) A 'whoosh' transition effect occurs between scene cuts. The speaker maintains clear articulation and high arousal, synchronized with the rhythmic music bed. (4) The audio interplay shifts to a descriptive tone as the speaker explains product features, though the BGM energy remains consistent. Another meow SFX is heard during the demonstration. (5) The master track concludes with a final enthusiastic verbal punchline and a slight music swell before a clean hard cut to silence.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Problem/Misconception -> Solution -> Feature Breakdown -> Scent Varieties -> Conclusion
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the Nomade portable fragrance machine by Berger. The video uses a humorous hook regarding male 'sexual tension' to pivot into a product pitch, detailing the convenience, technology (dry diffusion), and high-quality French fragrance capsules.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct demonstration of the product, detailed feature list, pricing/durability info, and brand logos prominently displayed.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video features a popular influencer style, using high-energy delivery and heavy graphic editing to maintain viewer retention for a commercial endorsement.
